fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $25,000 for a single Store. May be discounted or waived under promotional incentives: First Responders discount to $20,000; Military veterans discount to $15,000, or fully waived for veterans with 50%+ service-connected disability; Key Management Employee discounts range from 60% of standard fee (Level 1) to $10,000 (Level 2) to $5,000 (Level 3); Equipment Incentive Program waives the fee entirely for qualifying existing franchisees. In 2025, collected fees ranging from $1,000 to $25,000 (the $1,000 amount was offered to three existing franchisees reopening closed Stores). Development Agreement requires $5,000 per Store as a Development Fee, with a $5,000 credit applied toward each Store's Initial Franchise Fee. 2026 Royalty Incentive Program requires full Initial Franchise Fee ($25,000) for at least 3 Franchise Agreements with no Development Fee. Promotional discounts cannot be combined or transferred.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee for a single Store is $25,000 but may be discounted or waived if you qualify for and meet the obligations of one of our promotional incentives described below. Also, we reserve the right to negotiate the Franchise Fee with prospective franchisees in the future and may base such negotiations on a number of factors, including but not limited to previous experience, prior relationship with us, the number of Franchise Agreements granted, local market conditions, and other factors that we in our sole discretion may determine. In 2025, we collected Initial Franchise Fees ranging from $1,0001 to $25,000.
